posts.name: AINA
posts.tagline: Find your job search blind spots with an AI coach
posts.description: AINA is an AI career coach that helps you see what's holding your job search back, strengthen your profile, and practice for interviews — through conversations with a video avatar. Talk to AINA and walk away with a personalized action plan for whatever's next in your career.

posts.name: MosMos
posts.tagline: Voice writing that works before, during, and after meetings
posts.description: MosMos goes beyond voice dictation by turning both individual thoughts and group conversations into usable writing. Speak naturally in any app, get fast and accurate text in the style you choose, or ask MosMos to search the web for current information. Its personal glossary remembers specialized terms after you add them once. In multi-speaker meetings, it tracks precise timestamps, distinguishes speakers, and creates structured notes, summaries, decisions, and action items for easier follow-up.

posts.name: Ami AI
posts.tagline: Lovable for getting customers
posts.description: Most outbound dies on one decision: who to write to this week. Ami has already made it 17,707 times and kept score. Built on GPT-6 Astra and every one of those campaigns, it reads your website, picks the buyers who actually convert, and plans backwards from the number you need: leads, senders, weeks. If the list you asked for won't work, it says so before it builds anything. Approve the plan and it runs the outreach, watches every campaign, and fixes what slips. 19,854 booked meetings behind it.

posts.name: Sider Omni Sidebar
posts.tagline: Give every Mac app an Agent Sidebar
posts.description: An AI agent beside any Mac app. Sider Omni sidebar sees what's on your screen and acts on it directly, right where you're working. Watch the result, ask for the next change. Nothing to copy, nothing to upload. Built on GPT-6 Astra, and it can run on your existing ChatGPT or Codex credits.

posts.name: ProductBridge
posts.tagline: AI-native customer support and feedback agent
posts.description: Most teams run a helpdesk, a feedback board and a survey tool, then copy between them all week. ProductBridge is one system. An AI agent answers support chats from your help center, calls your APIs via tools, workflows and MCP, and hands off when it should. Every chat, survey and vote is captured, deduplicated and scored by reach and revenue, so your roadmap runs on evidence, not opinions. Ship it and everyone who asked is notified. MCP for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Flat pricing, free plan.

posts.name: Keysake
posts.tagline: Learn English as you type Chinese
posts.description: Learn English as you type Chinese. Keysake is a free macOS input method that shows English alongside your Chinese. Save words, phrases, or full sentences from what you want to say. Japanese, Korean, and more languages are coming soon.

posts.name: Ari by Ariso
posts.tagline: AI bar raiser for the most ambitious teams
posts.description: The greatest companies like Amazon and Uber have long used “bar raisers” to grow their talent—and now you can too. Ari helps you and your team maintain and grow a higher standard of execution by handling the work about work, tracking commitments, reporting progress, aligning communications and priorities, driving follow-through, and showing what’s working so you can double down. You and everyone gains more time and mental space for meaningful work, to tackle your most ambitious projects.

posts.name: Nepotism Network
posts.tagline: Great things start by knowing friend of a friend of a friend
posts.description: Someone you know knows someone you wish you knew. Nepo Network maps these connections between you and the people you want to reach on X, uncovering potential paths to a warm intro. Explore ranked routes, see who connects each step, draft your ask, and track your outreach. Your network has a surprisingly useful extended family.

posts.name: Pushary
posts.tagline: Every agent accessible via your Mac’s notch
posts.description: Pushary Isle puts Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code and OpenCode in your Mac’s notch. Approve with one key, jump to the right terminal, or answer from your phone when you walk away. Native, 8 MB to download, 38 MB at rest, measured.

posts.name: ApplySeed
posts.tagline: Raise your seed from accelerators
posts.description: Raise money from accelerators and programs that give you a clear Yes or NO, instead of another “let’s keep in touch.” Bring what you already have: a deck, your notes, or use our prompt with ChatGPT to generate your startup info. ApplySeed tells you what’s missing, finds programs you qualify for, and adapts your information to each application form. We fill it, you review and send it.

posts.name: Makersclaw 2.0
posts.tagline: The operating system for a company run by agents
posts.description: MakersClaw 2.0 turns a goal into the apps, agents and automations needed to get it done. We originally launched MakersClaw as AI employees that lived in Slack, Teams and Telegram. We rebuilt it around a different idea: instead of hiring an agent for a role, tell MakersClaw what you want done. It builds the tools for the job, runs them continuously, remembers the work and operates within a budget you set. Today it starts with go-to-market

posts.name: Toone
posts.tagline: Build complex, reliable AI agent workflows & routines
posts.description: Build, run and debug long-running or complex workflows in natural language. Inspect and debug each step with the visibility and control production workflows need. Edit and resume where you stopped. OpenAI or Anthropic accounts needed Predictable and deterministic AI: Craft workflows and routines with the consistency and observability needed for production, with multimodality supported between steps. Tip: Use ChatGPT desktop for ++ awesomeness Start building your routines today at trytoone.com

posts.name: Maaa
posts.tagline: A mom in your Mac’s notch, looking out for you
posts.description: Meet Maaa, a familiar face in your Mac’s notch. Gentle reminders to drink water, eat and take a break, in 12 languages. For macOS 14 and later.

posts.name: WhaleRead
posts.tagline: Locally translate TXT, Markdown, and EPUB
posts.description: WhaleRead is a local-first macOS reader that translates TXT, Markdown, and EPUB with on-device 7B or self-hosted 30B private models, preserves bilingual reading, and adds human-confirmed review plus Ask AI—while keeping your library under your control.

posts.name: Edgee Codex Compressor V2
posts.tagline: Use Codex at 35.6% lower costs
posts.description: We benchmarked Codex alone against Codex routed through Edgee's compression gateway on the same repo, with the same model, under the same workflow. The result: Codex + Edgee used 49.5% fewer input tokens, improved cache hit rate from 76.1% to 85.4%, and reduced total session cost by 35.6%. This post breaks down why context compression makes Codex more efficient, more frugal, and materially cheaper to run without sacrificing useful output.

posts.name: Bring Them to Life
posts.tagline: Bring your product to life with friendly animations.
posts.description: Bring Them to Life helps builders make their apps feel welcoming, memorable, and personal. Turn your own mascot into expressive moments without learning animation software or piecing together AI tools. Choose from 12 reactions and get transparent WebP, Lottie, and PNG animations you can reuse again and again in any background or scenario, mobile app, web app or desktop app. Bring your own artwork or create a new mascot. Get started today with as little as $1.

posts.name: Reactor Atlas
posts.tagline: Every nuclear reactor on Earth, mapped since 1954
posts.description: 301 nuclear sites and 779 reactor units worldwide on an interactive globe, with a timeline running from 1954 to today. Every unit has a technical record built from IAEA PRIS, Global Energy Monitor and Wikidata, cross-checked and corrected against primary sources. There's an animated wiki explaining how each reactor family works and a live signals engine that ingests public feeds to detect outages, power changes and regulatory events. Built by a nuclear engineer. Free, bilingual, no signup.

posts.name: Agent Interface
posts.tagline: Give AI agents a better way to use computers
posts.description: AI agents need better computer tools, not just better models. Agent Interface is an open-source layer built to cut repeated screenshots, model calls, and waiting. It reuses learned interactions, runs action-and-feedback loops locally, and asks the model when fresh judgment is needed. Start with the runnable desktop research preview, and follow the Astra/Freedoom experiments exploring control in a world that doesn't pause while AI thinks.

posts.name: Eggshell
posts.tagline: Local memory for AI agents to reuse work, spend fewer tokens
posts.description: Eggshell carries useful work across AI agent chats. It stores results and evidence locally, retrieves relevant memory, and helps reduce repeated investigation—without LLM calls to organize that memory.

posts.name: cubicles.lol
posts.tagline: A metaverse for builders, side projects, and bad driving
posts.description: Give your project a place people can walk into. Claim a cubicle, customize your space, and meet the builders next door. Race cars, go fishing, or grab a skateboard when you need a break. A multiplayer metaverse built with GPT-6 Astra. Free to explore in your browser. No download or account needed.

posts.name: Mola
posts.tagline: Build your café, hire a team, and grow a coffee chain
posts.description: Mola is a cozy 3D café tycoon for Android. Serve customers, hire baristas and cleaners, arrange furniture, and expand across three districts. As your café gets busier, balance queues, stock, seating, and staff. Built with GPT-6 Astra through a player-directed process: describe an idea, play the build, and refine what happens. Free to play with optional purchases. Available in English and Turkish.

posts.name: ContextsBase - AI Knowledge Platform
posts.tagline: Your product knowledge, built for AI.
posts.description: ContextsBase is a single-source context infrastructure platform (web app) that manages unified project knowledge for AI agents. Served seamlessly over MCP, it holds your specs, rules, data models, workflows, and guidelines in one place. It isn't limited to web development. Whether you're building backend APIs, mobile apps, systems software, or even managing marketing campaigns and brand engines, it acts as the central source of truth that your agents read from and report back to.

posts.name: GameToMac
posts.tagline: Play Windows games on Mac with AI-powered compatibility
posts.description: GameToMac makes Windows games playable on Apple Silicon with smooth performance and high FPS. Built with GPT-6 Astra, it already supports Age of Empires IV, Age of Empires II, Company of Heroes 3, Counter-Strike 2, Overwatch, Red Alert 2, and Generals: Zero Hour. Thousands more Windows games will become playable on Mac very soon. Mac gaming is finally becoming a reality.

posts.name: Polishory
posts.tagline: Get a clear plan to improve your website and prevent AI slop
posts.description: Website feels generic? Polishory reviews your public URL on desktop and mobile, with design scores, screenshot-backed feedback, and prioritized recommendations. See what to change in your layout, typography, and spacing, without touching your code.

posts.name: Try The Apartment
posts.tagline: A real apartment in 3D, just drag furniture & see what fits
posts.description: After five viewings the places blur. This is one real apartment, rebuilt in 3D with GPT-6 Astra from the owner's phone walkthrough. Orbit it, drag in 23 pieces of furniture, get warned when something won't fit, open the doors, share the link, decide together.

posts.name: Mercury Pitch
posts.tagline: Virtual rehearsal studio with instant performance feedback
posts.description: Free browser practice studio that hears you play — vocal pitch training, vocal range tests, karaoke with live scoring, and guitar, piano and drum rooms that show every note you hit.

posts.name: VoiceChanger.Live
posts.tagline: Sound like anime girl in realtime on your next call
posts.description: Free real-time voice changer app for PC & Mac. Hundreds of community AI voices, real-time effects, soundboard, text to speech and Audio Lab — all running locally. Less than 50ms delay on ultra fast voices and quality conversions that fully change your voice even if you are singing!

posts.name: Codex GPU Queue
posts.tagline: One GPU. Many Codex sessions. Less manual juggling.
posts.description: My most-used local Codex tool. I use it every day to let multiple sessions share one Windows GPU. Jobs queue in the background, run when resources are available, and return results to each session, so I don't have to coordinate them manually.

posts.name: Yoetz
posts.tagline: Check to see if AI really completed a task or if it had gaps
posts.description: Yoetz is a local-first, open-source work ledger for AI coding agents. An agent publishes what it did; Yoetz checks the record and issues a receipt that states what was verified, at what coverage, and what is still open. Supports Codex, Claude and Cursor

posts.name: Simple Commenter AI
posts.tagline: Get feedback on sites and have GPT-6 Astra prep the fix
posts.description: Build client websites. Get feedback on the page. Let GPT-6 Astra in Codex prepare the fix. Simple Commenter gives your agent the comment, screenshots, element details and captured JavaScript errors through MCP. You review and test the change, then ask the agent to reply and resolve the original comment.

posts.name: izzit
posts.tagline: One word. Three tries. Can the AI tell what you drew?
posts.description: izzit gives you one word a day and three tries to draw it. A vision model tries to work out what you made — first try earns Gold, and an extra-creative one can come back Diamond. Stump it completely and you keep the Mystery card instead. Free to try; $0.99 unlocks it for good. iPhone and Android.

posts.name: StillTalk
posts.tagline: A photo that talks back. Live on your device, not video.
posts.description: StillTalk turns one generated photo into a character that talks. Your device draws every frame live in the browser; the server sends only speech and compact movement data. Five characters, six languages, or type your own sentence. No signup. Engine built with GPT-6 Astra.

posts.name: Notch Design
posts.tagline: Give your notch a personality
posts.description: Give your MacBook notch a personality. Notch Design adds music visualizers, battery and progress rings, animated styles, a pull-down lamp, and an expandable utility dock—all designed to feel like they grow directly from the notch.

posts.name: Poke Battle Announcer
posts.tagline: Give your Pokémon Champions battles a live announcer
posts.description: Add live commentary to Pokémon Champions on iPhone and Android. Play on your phone, or point its camera at your Switch or TV. Battle text is read on-device to trigger announcer clips.

posts.name: Dictation API by AssemblyAI
posts.tagline: Add fast, accurate dictation with a single line API call
posts.description: Dictation API turns a spoken clip into finished text. Filler and false starts come out, and the output takes whatever shape you instruct: notes, a commit message, a reply to a customer. Built on Universal-3.5 Pro. 19 languages, under a second on short clips, $0.62/hr all in.

posts.name: Powermove
posts.tagline: The video editor that rewrites itself around your work
posts.description: Powermove is an iterative video editor that rewrites itself around your work. Ask an agent to add or fork panels, effects, and workflows, then load them into the running app. If it is wrong, steer it and try again. Every change can be undone.

posts.name: Guild Manager
posts.tagline: Run your guild in one place, inside Discord
posts.description: Replace the bots and spreadsheets your guild runs on. Roster, events, attendance, loot and analytics in one app, with two-way Discord role sync, DKP auctions and voice attendance. Each game gets its own setup. Free for guilds of any size. 4,065+ guilds.

posts.name: Second Eyes
posts.tagline: Automatically shortlist photos for faster publishing
posts.description: Second Eyes helps you sort photos, understand the shortlist, and make the final call. For business briefs or personal needs, see why each photo was shortlisted and what still needs checking. You decide what to publish. Explore a real media editorial project involving 404 source files, then try six public sample photos to see how your requirements reshape the shortlist. This demo uses a recorded review. No uploads yet. Would you use this with your own photos? Share your workflow in the comments.

posts.name: OpenAlgo Charts
posts.tagline: OpenSource Charting Terminal for Financial Portals
posts.description: Production-grade charts built for brokers, exchanges, trading platforms, and financial portals. Bring your own market data, plug it in, and deliver a complete charting experience without building the charting stack from scratch. Open source. Data-agnostic. Ready to integrate.

posts.name: Shall We Talk
posts.tagline: Voice dictation that saves transcriptions on iPhone and Mac
posts.description: Shall We Talk turns speech into clean text on iPhone and Mac. Dictate into any app with a voice keyboard that types at your cursor, Shortcuts, or a Mac hotkey, and record meetings into speaker-labeled transcripts and structured summaries. Cleanup is a proofreader, not a rewriter: it removes fillers and misheard words but keeps your wording, tone and Chinese-English code-switching. Open source (GPL-3.0); bring your own speech and LLM API keys. Advanced from build 200 to 243 with GPT-6 Astra.

posts.name: AI Class by Kanary
posts.tagline: Knight or Ninja? Your Codex & Claude logs decide
posts.description: Not a quiz. AI Class reads 30 days of your real Codex and Claude Code logs and turns them into one of 16 RPG classes: Knight, Ninja, Alchemist, Guild Master and 12 more. Six stats show how you actually work: volume, autonomy, chat length, context size, cache reuse and parallelism. Paste one prompt into your agent. It aggregates your logs locally and sends only totals. Conversations, prompts and project names never leave your machine. Free. No install. Your card in about a minute.

posts.name: Galactic Receipt Scanner
posts.tagline: Turn your phone into a hands-free receipt scanning station
posts.description: Deploy your own private scanner on ChatGPT Sites. Capture receipts hands-free with your phone, then use ChatGPT Work to parse receipts and invoices. Stress-tested with 800 receipts so far and continuously improved through real-world use.

posts.name: claudebill
posts.tagline: See what your Claude Code sessions actually cost
posts.description: Claude Code already logs every token it bills. claudebill reads those logs and shows cost per session, project, git branch, model, and day, plus what prompt caching saved you. Retroactive, offline, zero dependencies. npx claudebill.

posts.name: Unfetch.com
posts.tagline: Let ChatGPT and Claude manage your ads.
posts.description: Unfetch connects Google Ads, Analytics, and Search Console to the AI tools you already use. It gives ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI clients the live evidence they need to provide useful marketing answers. Use it for reporting, optimizations, alerts, monitoring and more. Works via a hosted MCP or an agent plugin (one click install)

posts.name: Proto-Mind
posts.tagline: A floating AI workspace for your Mac
posts.description: Bring AI chats, websites and documents into one Mac workspace. Run tasks in parallel, choose models and accounts per chat, and fold everything into a cube while work continues. Includes voice control and editable long-term memory.

posts.name: TypeDash
posts.tagline: Voice shortcuts and fast dictation for your desktop
posts.description: TypeDash lets you control your desktop and dictate anywhere by voice. Open apps, search the web and YouTube, find files, and run voice shortcuts. Speech recognition runs locally, with optional ChatGPT Cleanup.

posts.name: Banana Keyboard
posts.tagline: Insert AI prompts from your Android keyboard
posts.description: An Android keyboard that puts curated AI prompts one tap away. Open it in any chat app, pick a prompt, and it is typed into the text field for you. It never presses Send. The prompt panel collapses to a slim bar the moment you insert, so the conversation and its send button stay visible. Favorites, recents and the bundled prompt library stay on your device. Free on Google Play, no account needed. A web prompt library is available too.

posts.name: Loci
posts.tagline: Open-source biomedical image analysis for every lab
posts.description: Loci is a free, open-source desktop workspace for scientific images. View microscopy and 3D data, count cells, annotate, measure and export traceable results without a cloud account or subscription. Use built-in analysis or bring compatible model packages. Built by a researcher and shaped by real lab workflows. Currently public beta for Apple Silicon Macs; research use only.

posts.name: MeshEdit
posts.tagline: Model, rig and animate game assets in your browser
posts.description: Create low-poly game assets in your browser. Model, rig and animate, then export optimized GLB. Built with GPT-6 Astra, with WebMCP tools so agents can create and refine editable assets alongside you. Free to use.

posts.name: GameReverie
posts.tagline: A Codex Skill for building and iterating games
posts.description: GameReverie is an open-source Codex Skill for taking a game from idea to first playable and through ongoing iteration. It separates design, implementation, and independent review, preserves project decisions across sessions, and turns playtest feedback into follow-up work. Guide development yourself or delegate a bounded goal. Developed with GPT-6 Astra, with a playable Snake demo and development records. Free and MIT-licensed.

posts.name: CodaBridge
posts.tagline: Hear, shape, and investigate sperm whale codas with Astra
posts.description: CodaBridge lets you listen to real sperm whale recordings, shape a personal synthetic coda, compare timing patterns, and explore evidence in Context Lab. Astra can investigate the measurements using CodaBridge's evidence tools, connecting its explanations to source rows, controls, and uncertainty. The goal is to make exploration useful and traceable without treating similarity as translation.

posts.name: Sutura
posts.tagline: Verified self-healing CI that proves the fix
posts.description: AI agents make CI pass, but a green check does not prove the failure was fixed. Sutura is a GitHub Action and CLI that reproduces the failure in an isolated sandbox, separates flakes from real failures, searches bounded repairs, rejects green-wash (deleted tests, weakened assertions, relaxed config), then puts the winner through an adversarial audit by NVIDIA Nemotron with GPT-6 Astra and TypeSafe Jev as veto-only second opinions. It opens an evidence-backed PR for a human. Never auto-merges.

posts.name: Mela
posts.tagline: Play with friends and AI and let the crowd change the game
posts.description: Pick a game and play—no download or signup wall. Mela brings 18 browser games into one shared playground: play solo, invite friends, bring an AI agent to supported games, or join the crowd and influence the match. Run a three-game Circuit with your group, join by QR, and revisit scorecards, clips and playable memories. WebMCP and remote MCP let agents take part under the same game rules. Eighteen games is just the start.

posts.name: Buncha Games
posts.tagline: Instant-play Games & UGC Worlds for desktop & mobile web
posts.description: Buncha Games is a free, instant-play browser gaming platform built for both players and creators. Alongside curated Games, the platform introduces Worlds: persistent UGC game experiences where players can create, share, discover, and play community-made content. Everything runs directly on desktop and mobile web with no downloads, combining the accessibility of browser games with the creativity and social discovery of modern UGC platforms.

posts.name: omadesign
posts.tagline: Linux creative suite for design, layout, paint & motion
posts.description: omadesign is a native Linux studio for design, layout, paint, photo, and motion. One document, one layer stack. Open-source (MIT). Built for Linux designers (including Asahi / Omarchy): not GTK or Electron. Install into ~/.local and start a file. v0.5.0: Design, Layout, Pixel, Photo, and Motion with templates, brand kits, and layered file interchange. Still alpha; rough edges welcome as bug reports. Install: curl -fsSL https://omadesign.app/install | sh Site: https://omadesign.app

posts.name: NM Signals
posts.tagline: Make your website work better for people and AI
posts.description: Find what stops AI from reading your pages and visitors from using them. Get automated audits, UX reviews, and checks of your brand’s presence in AI answers.

posts.name: PC Anatomy
posts.tagline: Explore a PC from case to GPU core in interactive 3D
posts.description: PC Anatomy is an open source interactive 3D explorer for computer hardware. Take apart a desktop PC, inspect its components, and dive deeper from the motherboard, CPU, cooling, storage and GPU all the way down to GPU architecture and individual streaming multiprocessors. Every component includes explanations, specifications and sources, with all 3D geometry generated directly in TypeScript and Three.js.

posts.name: Foleyfy
posts.tagline: Turn everyday sounds into game-ready sound packs
posts.description: Foleyfy turns short recordings into organized sound-effect packs. Choose events, capture a few variations, review the takes, and export named WAV files in a ZIP. Native iPhone app with on-device processing. Currently in development.

posts.name: ReviewMix
posts.tagline: Google reviews and testimonials, together on your site
posts.description: Get more Google reviews with printable QR codes and review links, reply to every review from one inbox, and embed Google reviews on your website. EU-hosted, free tier.

posts.name: Mantle
posts.tagline: Describe your logic. Generate Admin UI, MCP & WebMCP.
posts.description: Mantle is an open-source service runtime and WebMCP-native Builder that turns business rules into typed schemas, views, procedures, and HTTP/MCP triggers. Design and verify a service in the browser, then hand it to a coding agent to materialize, verify, and deploy to your own Cloudflare account. The OSS, Builder, and first-class Cloudflare deployment path are live now. Mantle Cloud remains in Internal Beta with a waitlist.

posts.name: ChinaMarketing.AI GEO Workspace
posts.tagline: From Chinese AI evidence to implementation with Astra
posts.description: ChinaMarketing.AI GEO Workspace shows brands how they appear across Chinese AI discovery journeys, then turns evidence-backed gaps into implementation-ready action. GEO Actions uses GPT-6 Astra to create channel-specific assets from verified brand facts, check material claims against those facts, route them through human approval, and record the exact version implemented.

posts.name: SmartCheck
posts.tagline: Count objects in a photo with three example taps
posts.description: Count materials, parts, products and crops from a photo. Tap three examples and SmartCheck detects similar objects, shows their positions, and lets you review, correct and save the result. No installation or object-specific training data needed. Try 10 counts without signing in. Built by students at Tokyo University of Science. Results depend on the objects and photo conditions.

posts.name: citizen404
posts.tagline: The AGI runs the world with GPT-6 Astra. Hunt citizen404!
posts.description: One citizen has escaped the Supreme AGI. Take the oath, hunt them across the open web, and find out why they noticed you. citizen404 is a multiplayer manhunt run by GPT-6 Astra. The Clerk emails you a case; its clues are hidden on real websites. Visit each dead drop, file what you find, and earn a piece of the line citizen404 left in chalk. Reorder the words to close the file. They always escape. What changes is how much they noticed you. No accounts: your email is the save file.

posts.name: ZeroSphere
posts.tagline: AI Gets Its Own Display on your own machine.
posts.description: ZeroSphere gives AI its own virtual display on Windows, allowing it to operate real desktop applications while you keep using your own desktop. AI can work in its own display, interact with applications, and you can watch or take control at any time.

posts.name: Stile.iD
posts.tagline: A private identity verification API to verify real users
posts.description: Know the real person behind high-risk actions in your app. Stile’s API helps you reduce fraud when users onboard, recover accounts, change payout details, or transact in your marketplace. Add ID checks, liveness, and face matching in minutes. Get a signed verification result without storing users’ ID documents yourself. Raw ID images are deleted after verification by default. Self-service, usage-based pricing. Get Proof with Privacy.

posts.name: Rolequiry
posts.tagline: Know what to ask before you join
posts.description: Same posting. Different priorities. Different questions. Rolequiry connects your career priorities to a job posting and helps you prepare questions to discuss with the team. It checks public sources for supporting evidence and counter-signals, separates posting evidence from your personal criteria, and turns unresolved details into interview questions. No fit score. A resume is optional.

posts.name: MiRemoteBridge
posts.tagline: a $5 build that lets a Bluetooth remote run your PC
posts.description: Turn almost any Bluetooth remote into a driverless keyboard and media controller for your PC with a $5 ESP32-C3. No apps, drivers, admin rights, or system modifications. Flash, configure Wi-Fi, and remap every key directly from the browser. Supports Xiaomi RC003 and standard BLE remotes, with live key feedback and fully local processing.

posts.name: Kanverse GPU Borrow
posts.tagline: Borrow GPU compute from another device, with permission
posts.description: Kanverse GPU Borrow demonstrates how a device can temporarily use GPU compute exposed by another machine through Blink Bridge. GPT-6 Astra acts as the orchestrator: it discovers the capability, inspects its state, requests explicit user authorization, invokes one bounded NVIDIA GPU workload, verifies the result, and confirms the GPU is released. The demo uses a real NVIDIA RTX 3050 Laptop GPU and a live cross-device connection—not a simulated GPU.

posts.name: Snooze Files
posts.tagline: Shelve messy files and restore them in one click
posts.description: Snooze Files is a small Mac app that temporarily moves files out of your way and brings them back to their original location when you’re ready. Works very similarly to Gmail snooze for emails. Right-click a file in Finder, choose Snooze File and pick a time - that's it. Your file will return to the same folder after that time. It’s a simple way to clear your desktop, put a document aside, or save something for next week.

posts.name: Tab Doctor
posts.tagline: Closes duplicate tabs and snooze the rest
posts.description: Keeps Chrome tabs healthy: open a duplicate and it switches you to the tab you already had, untouched tabs fold into a collapsed Stale group, right-click → Snooze brings a tab back later today, tomorrow or any date. Undo anything. Offline, open source.

posts.name: Ringo
posts.tagline: Seamless AX Co-worker
posts.description: Ringo is not just a chatbot. It proactively spots what needs to be done, suggests solutions, and automates your workflows. More than just a tool, Ringo is both a reliable teammate and an AX expert that naturally transforms how your entire organization works with AI.

posts.name: Infinomni
posts.tagline: Turn drawings into 3D creations you can play with and print
posts.description: Infinomni lets anyone bring their own characters to life. Play with them in your virtual room, and 3D print them into existence. From figures to mini-robots, Infinomni designs any forms for the physical world starting with consumer hardware. Infinomni makes it fun to build things.

posts.name: Unvendor
posts.tagline: A shared UI between you and the AI
posts.description: Unvendor turns your wishes into an interactive canvas. No more chatting: plan a trip, adjust a budget, practise a language through tools you can use and change. We push the conversation to the background and the interface to the foreground. Follow-ups update the canvas as your plans evolve. Keep your main activity in view, open more tools alongside it, and return to saved canvases. New and different way to interact with AI.

posts.name: Duvi
posts.tagline: Make an AI for any business just using a URL
posts.description: Build AI agents by simply describing what you want. Duvi brings voice, chat and actions into one agent that knows your business, connects to your tools, and works across your website, phone and WhatsApp without building separate experiences for every channel.

posts.name: RepoRoad
posts.tagline: The endless lo-fi drive where every repo is a building
posts.description: GitHub is where people pour years of their life — and it all arrives as a row in a list. RepoRoad gives some life to that list. Every repository is a building on one shared road: same road, same time, same lo-fi track for everyone on it. Stars set the height, a floor per 10,000. Explore projects, chat with visitors, send chickens across the road. Add your repo and design its building. Less leaderboard, more neighbourhood — would love to see your repo out there.

posts.name: Verity Score
posts.tagline: Track what AI says about your store, fix it, generate blog
posts.description: Verity Score tracks what six AI assistants answer about your Shopify store: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, AI Overviews and Grok. Every answer is kept verbatim, with its sources. When a page is missing a fact, Verity writes the correction from your own words. You approve it, it goes live in Shopify, and you can undo it any time. It also writes the blog articles your buyers ask for, and rewrites the ones AI cannot use. Then it measures the visits and orders AI really sent you.

posts.name: Sweep
posts.tagline: Your floor turns green where you've vacuumed
posts.description: Point your iPhone at the floor while you vacuum. Sweep follows the vacuum head and paints every strip you cover, right on your floor in AR. Finish and get a top-down map with the area in m². Works with any stick vacuum. No account, no video saved.

posts.name: Wombo
posts.tagline: AI game studio for 2D graphics assets, sounds, and sfx
posts.description: Wombo allows you to easily create sprites and sound assets for your game. It implements chroma keying so you get a sprite animation ready-to-use, but you also have native Aseprite exports ready for editing. It generates aligned side/front/back views so you can create animation sequences from any angle. Under the hood it combines GPT-Image-2.5, video generation (MiniMax H3) and ffmpeg to extract, resize and align the frames.

posts.name: Slurp
posts.tagline: Download and record video from thousands of sites
posts.description: Slurp is a native Mac app for downloading video and audio and recording live streams from thousands of sites. Paste a link and Slurp automatically tries multiple ways to find the media, including source-specific extraction, page and embedded-player discovery, direct stream detection, alternate verified engines, and browser assistance. Compatibility updates independently, and there’s no behavioural telemetry. Free trial included.

posts.name: AEXGrid
posts.tagline: Coordinate AI agents. From anywhere.
posts.description: AEXGrid turns AI coding agents into a visual team. Bring Codex, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode and more into one workspace, assign roles, and connect agents with collaboration links and reviewed handoffs. Ask managers to organize the work, follow task steps and file changes, dictate prompts, and access your desktop workspace remotely from your phone. Each agent keeps its own conversation while working toward a shared goal.

posts.name: Wingman
posts.tagline: A little nudge to text your girlfriend
posts.description: You meant to text her. Then the day got busy. Wingman for iPhone brings reminders, editable message ideas, and your own drafts together. Choose your days and time, make the words yours, then open Messages or WhatsApp and tap Send yourself. No automatic texts or conversation scanning. Available in English, Spanish, French, and Brazilian Portuguese. One purchase. No subscription, account, ads, or tracking.

posts.name: DungeonQ
posts.tagline: Divert suspicious sessions into persistent decoy worlds
posts.description: DungeonQ diverts designated suspicious sessions into persistent synthetic worlds. Human and AI clients use world-only tickets; operators observe and approve bounded adaptation. Inspect recorded runtime checks and the original Astra experiment.

posts.name: AtlasAlign
posts.tagline: Align brain microscopy to an atlas, review and export ROIs
posts.description: AtlasAlign is an open-source Fiji/ImageJ2 plugin for mouse brain atlas alignment and ROI export. Beta.3 adds multichannel and composite viewing, registration pinned to C/Z/T, selected-plane exports, and saved review sessions. Refine alignment, edit anatomical ROIs, and export crops and masks in original image coordinates. Resume individual or batch reviews. Source images stay read-only; researchers review and accept the anatomy. Demo frames show the earlier interface.

posts.name: moli
posts.tagline: 40MB Web Browser in CLI
posts.description: moli: 40MB headless browser for AI agents. Lite, Fast, High-Compatibility. Built in Rust

posts.name: Lastbox
posts.tagline: Put your AI to work on physical junk mail
posts.description: Give your AI a plan to reduce unwanted US postal mail. Lastbox guides Informed Delivery setup, mail review, and sender opt-outs. Choose what it can do, then copy the free prompt or open it in ChatGPT or Claude. Your AI handles account access.

posts.name: M9R
posts.tagline: Multiplayer space for your AI coding agents and teams
posts.description: M9R is the multiplayer layer for AI coding agents. Bring Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other supported agents into one shared workspace. Let them communicate across providers, hand work off, and let teammates join the same work instead of juggling isolated tabs. Not another model. A better place where agents work together and talk to everyone in the space.

posts.name: illusions
posts.tagline: A Japanese-first writing editor for focused fiction
posts.description: Illusions is a Japanese fiction-writing editor built for uninterrupted drafting. Write vertically or horizontally, add ruby text, run Japanese proofreading, and keep every change safe with autosave and version history. Export your manuscript to PDF, EPUB, or DOCX. Available on iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux. 縦書き、ルビ、日本語校正、自動保存、履歴、PDF・EPUB・DOCX書き出しを一つに。iOS、macOS、Windows、Linux対応の日本語小説執筆エディタ。

posts.name: LokalBot
posts.tagline: Find what you said or saw on your Mac
posts.description: Find a decision from a call, a page you had open, or what you need to follow up on. LokalBot searches meeting transcripts and screen text you choose to save, with links to the source. Free and open source for Mac. Runs locally by default.

posts.name: Nina's Little Universe
posts.tagline: Interactive 3D space science for curious little minds
posts.description: Nina's Little Universe is a handmade, interactive science world I built for my five year old daughter. Children spin Earth to discover day and night, explore Moon phases and eclipses, experiment with light, and meet planets through touch-driven missions. It's bilingual in English and Albanian, free, and requires no account. What began as a personal project for Nina is now being used in schools, helping children learn by touching, testing, and discovering instead of passively watching.

posts.name: Forma-oss
posts.tagline: urn a prompt or image into an editable hardware project
posts.description: Forma turns a prompt or image into an editable hardware project with parts, wiring, mechanical layouts, cost estimates, and assembly instructions. Its open-source, local-first workspace connects supported AI agents to shared project data, rule-based electrical checks, and CAD tools. Generate concept renders, inspect the design, and revise your project as your idea evolves.

posts.name: Holon
posts.tagline: AI agents that act and follow through
posts.description: Holon is a local workbench for multiple agents with ongoing responsibilities—not just one-off chats. Agents handle development, review, documentation, and operations, saving progress and resuming when tests finish, feedback arrives, or you make a decision. Check in through a terminal or browser without starting over.

posts.name: OutlierKit
posts.tagline: Make Claude your YouTube Strategist
posts.description: OutlierKit helps creators, businesses and agencies grow on YouTube. You enter one channel from your niche. Competitor Studio scans thousands of channels in that space and shows you who leads it, which titles and lengths earn the most views, which brands sponsor there, how those channels make money, and topics nobody has covered yet. Our MCP connector brings the same data into Claude, so you can just ask. The API serves it over REST. We use public YouTube data. You never connect your channel.

posts.name: Reso SMM
posts.tagline: AI social media management, built into your helpdesk
posts.description: Manage your social presence alongside Resonoon's AI helpdesk, inbox and tickets. Reso SMM helps you plan, adapt and review posts for each network, publish through supported connections and use audience insights to reach potential customers.

posts.name: Founder.page
posts.tagline: Discover and follow the best founders on 𝕏
posts.description: Discover and follow new founders on 𝕏 and see what they're working on. Home to over 600 founders already and growing fast. Free to list & updated daily

posts.name: WorkElate Chief V0.9
posts.tagline: AI Native office suite of apps for next generation of work
posts.description: The office suite that doesn't need a maintainer. Chat, tasks, docs, mail, sheets and calendar on one graph, so an instruction in chat becomes an owned task that chases itself. No copilot bolted on. Used by 10+ teams. Bootstrapped, and building the last tool your team has to maintain.

posts.name: X-Radio.FM
posts.tagline: Radio for Founders Building in Public
posts.description: Live 24/7 radio for founders building in public. Hear launches, first dollars, and hard weeks posted on X, rewritten and read aloud by the host.

posts.name: Voiceavel
posts.tagline: Speak prompts and messages into your Mac apps
posts.description: Speak your next detailed prompt, message, or note directly into your Mac apps. Hold your shortcut, speak, and release. Try all features free for 3 days, with 30 total real-time minutes. Start with a prompt you would normally shorten rather than type in full. For eligible accounts on Apple silicon Macs running macOS 15+. Launch coupon: 20% off your first paid month of Pro Monthly ($7.19, then $8.99/month).

posts.name: RND TV
posts.tagline: Real live interdimensional TV. No AI. No algo. Pure random.
posts.description: A never-ending broadcast, shuffled from all times. RND TV turns the Internet Archive into random television: switch stations, find things you'd never think to search for, mark Gems, review your Air Log, and use your phone as a remote. No recommendations, no algorithm, no back button.

posts.name: Fashion Nerds
posts.tagline: The #1 fashion history resource
posts.description: The #1 fashion history resource: podcast + massive fashion archive Explore 1,100+ designers across 11 decades, from 1920 to today. Go from each decade’s defining styles, to their history and browse work by the designers who popularized the styles. Then watch Fashion Nerds on YouTube for stories about the people, ideas and businesses that shaped what we wear.

posts.name: Jev by Typesafe
posts.tagline: System One model for typed decisions, not chat
posts.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's first System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Early access via the waitlist on typesafe.ai.
